headword: {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}

definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that is carefully and completely prepared, with no detail overlooked. A four-character compound (yojijukugo) expressing thoroughness in preparation.

examples.japanese: {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}な{計画|けいかく}だ。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{用意周到|よういしゅうとう}に{準備|じゅんび}を{進|すす}めた。
examples.english: She proceeded with her preparations meticulously.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}は{用意周到|よういしゅうとう}に{証拠|しょうこ}を{隠滅|いんめつ}していた。
examples.english: The culprit had meticulously destroyed the evidence.

notes:
A yojijukugo ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) combining {用意|ようい} (preparation) and {周到|しゅうとう} (thorough, careful). It is always positive in describing the quality of preparation, though it can be used for both good and bad actors (e.g., a criminal who planned carefully).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}な{人|ひと}: a well-prepared person
- {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}な{作戦|さくせん}: a meticulously planned operation
- {用意周到|よういしゅうとう}に{行動|こうどう}する: to act with thorough preparation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {周到|しゅうとう}: thorough, careful — the second half of this compound, usable on its own
- {万全|ばんぜん}: perfect, flawless — emphasizes completeness of preparation
- {念入|ねんい}り: careful, thorough — emphasizes taking extra care with details
